newsitem.title: THAILAND: New Thai finmin Thanong to hold news conference. [CORRECTED 13:05 GMT]
newsitem.headline: New Thai finmin Thanong to hold news conference. [CORRECTED 13:05 GMT]

text.p: New Thai Finance Minister Thanong Bidaya will hold a press conference at 8.30 p.m. local (1330 GMT) on Friday following his appointment, a government official said.
Thanong, a banker, was named to replace Amnuay Viravan who resigned after policy differences with political rivals in the six-party coalition government of Thai Prime Minister Chavalit Yongchaiyudh.
